title: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang will appear before a House Foreign Affairs panel amid concerns over his affair with a suspected Chinese spy
content: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang will appear before the  House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence, and China Select Committees on December 1, with Nvidia's lawyer following him on December 2. The appearances follow Huang's admission of an affair with a woman who worked for an Nvidia customer who is also believed to be a Chinese spy.

title: AMD attacks Nvidia's FP64 emulation at SC26, touts native double-precision on Instinct MI430X
